results.title: CMS Transmittal 1875 - Consultation service codes no longer recognized for Medicare payment
results.text:
# Medicare consultation code elimination, January 1, 2010

## Policy change

Effective January 1, 2010, Medicare stopped recognizing consultation service codes 99241-99245 and 99251-99255 for Part B payment under the physician fee schedule. The change was applied budget-neutrally across inpatient and office/outpatient settings, with limited exceptions for telehealth consultation G-codes.

## Rationale

CMS restructured evaluation and management (E/M) payment. The transmittal states that the agency increased the work relative value units (RVUs) for new and established office visits and increased payment for initial hospital and nursing facility visits. These increased values were also carried into practice expense and malpractice calculations and into the E/M component of global surgical codes.

final_text:
For claim 324308, CARC 16 is the most plausible code, but only weakly. The claim's denial probability is 0.1057. That is 0.59 times the validation average of 0.1805, or -7.5 percentage points below it. So the model does not flag this claim as likely to be denied.

**Why CARC 16:** The project's paraphrase of CARC 16 is "the claim is missing information or has a billing error." It maps to the project rules provider_outlier and missing_hcpcs. The biggest upward push comes from the billing provider NPI (CARR_CLM_BLG_NPI_NUM), at 0.813 log-odds, which is a 125% rise in the odds. The model weighs that feature upward, which fits the provider-based rule. The data dictionary doesn't document this feature. This is a loose link, not a finding of an outlier.

**What lowers the score:** The model weighs HCPCS 99495 downward (-1.097, a 67% drop in the odds). The tool describes that code as transitional care management. The diagnosis P292 adds almost nothing (0.043), so CARC 11 has little support from the model.

The policy documents don't cover this code. The denial label here is synthetic, so any CARC is illustrative.
